Subject: Recap + EOQ check: Redwood x StellarApps discovery

Hi Alexandra — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Use case: AI-first support triage + knowledge retrieval for tier-1/2 agents (hybrid chat + KB embeddings).
- Target metric: 30% deflection on support volume within 90 days of rollout.
- Success criteria: latency < 300ms p95 on production traffic, cost target ~$0.004/token blended.
- Technical checklist we discussed: API integration points, data retention (14 days for session logs), and SSO + SCIM for agents.

Agreed next steps:
1) I’ll share an initial SOW and implementation timeline for review (attached).
2) Your team to confirm priority and procurement timeline (you mentioned EOQ approval window).
3) Schedule a 60-min technical kickoff with our solutions engineer (Marissa) next week if procurement aligns.

Attachments: StellarApps-Initial-SOW-draft.pdf (SOW draft), redwood-product-sheet.pdf

Please confirm: is EOQ still the right timeline for approval on your side, or has priority shifted? If it is still EOQ, we can line up the kickoff for the week of Apr 6 and optionally pull in our delivery lead for scoping.

Thanks — Jordan
